<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><base><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>Fuel & Free Time — Earned Hours / Revise Draft</title><style>/* Shared geometry only. Theme packages map character onto these roles. */
:root {
  --iam-layout-max: 1440px;
  --iam-layout-wide: 1320px;
  --iam-layout-content: 1200px;
  --iam-layout-reading: 760px;
  --iam-layout-gutter: clamp(16px, 4vw, 56px);

  --iam-section-y-sm: clamp(48px, 7vw, 80px);
  --iam-section-y-md: clamp(64px, 9vw, 120px);
  --iam-section-y-lg: clamp(80px, 11vw, 160px);

  --iam-touch-min: 44px;
}

.iam-layout-max,
.iam-layout-wide,
.iam-layout-content,
.iam-layout-reading {
  width: min(100% - (var(--iam-layout-gutter) * 2), var(--iam-layout-width));
  margin-inline: auto;
  min-width: 0;
}

.iam-layout-max { --iam-layout-width: var(--iam-layout-max); }
.iam-layout-wide { --iam-layout-width: var(--iam-layout-wide); }
.iam-layout-content { --iam-layout-width: var(--iam-layout-content); }
.iam-layout-reading { --iam-layout-width: var(--iam-layout-reading); }
.iam-layout-full { width: 100%; min-width: 0; }

.iam-section-space-sm { padding-block: var(--iam-section-y-sm); }
.iam-section-space-md { padding-block: var(--iam-section-y-md); }
.iam-section-space-lg { padding-block: var(--iam-section-y-lg); }

.iam-safe-inline {
  padding-left: max(0px, calc(env(safe-area-inset-left) - var(--iam-layout-gutter)));
  padding-right: max(0px, calc(env(safe-area-inset-right) - var(--iam-layout-gutter)));
}

[data-section] {
  container-type: inline-size;
  min-width: 0;
}

.iam-touch-target {
  min-width: var(--iam-touch-min);
  min-height: var(--iam-touch-min);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  touch-action: manipulation;
}

img,
video,
canvas,
model-viewer {
  max-width: 100%;
}

button,
a,
input,
select,
textarea {
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

@media (max-width: 767px) {
  input,
  select,
  textarea {
    font-size: max(16px, 1rem);
  }
}

/* src/tokens/layout.css */
:root,
[data-theme="revise"] {
  --revise-layout-max: 1440px;
  --revise-layout-wide: 1320px;
  --revise-layout-content: 1200px;
  --revise-layout-reading: 760px;
  --revise-gutter: clamp(16px, 4vw, 56px);

  --iam-layout-max: var(--revise-layout-max);
  --iam-layout-wide: var(--revise-layout-wide);
  --iam-layout-content: var(--revise-layout-content);
  --iam-layout-reading: var(--revise-layout-reading);
  --iam-layout-gutter: var(--revise-gutter);
}


/* src/tokens/color.css */
:root,
[data-theme="revise"] {
  --revise-surface-canvas: #f1eee7;
  --revise-surface-elevated: #faf8f3;
  --revise-surface-muted: #e4dfd5;
  --revise-surface-inverse: #11110f;

  --revise-text-primary: #151512;
  --revise-text-secondary: #646159;
  --revise-text-inverse: #f8f5ee;

  --revise-border-subtle: rgba(21, 21, 18, 0.14);
  --revise-border-strong: rgba(21, 21, 18, 0.34);

  --revise-action-primary: var(--brand-color-primary, #151512);
  --revise-action-primary-text: var(--brand-color-on-primary, #f8f5ee);
  --revise-action-soft: rgba(21, 21, 18, 0.08);

  --revise-scrim: rgba(9, 9, 8, 0.36);
  --revise-focus: var(--brand-color-accent, #6b72ff);
}


/* src/tokens/typography.css */
:root,
[data-theme="revise"] {
  --revise-font-display: var(--brand-font-display, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif);
  --revise-font-body: var(--brand-font-body, Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif);
  --revise-font-mono: var(--brand-font-mono, "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, monospace);

  --revise-text-xs: clamp(0.72rem, 0.69rem + 0.12vw, 0.8rem);
  --revise-text-sm: clamp(0.84rem, 0.8rem + 0.18vw, 0.94rem);
  --revise-text-md: clamp(1rem, 0.95rem + 0.25vw, 1.12rem);
  --revise-text-lg: clamp(1.18rem, 1.06rem + 0.55vw, 1.52rem);

  --revise-display-sm: clamp(2rem, 1.62rem + 1.8vw, 3.1rem);
  --revise-display-md: clamp(2.7rem, 1.9rem + 3.5vw, 4.8rem);
  --revise-display-lg: clamp(3.4rem, 2rem + 5.8vw, 7rem);
  --revise-display-xl: clamp(4rem, 2rem + 8vw, 9.5rem);

  --revise-leading-tight: 0.94;
  --revise-leading-copy: 1.62;
  --revise-tracking-display: -0.045em;
  --revise-tracking-label: 0.13em;
}


/* src/tokens/spacing.css */
:root,
[data-theme="revise"] {
  --revise-space-1: clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 8px);
  --revise-space-2: clamp(8px, 0.8vw, 12px);
  --revise-space-3: clamp(12px, 1.2vw, 18px);
  --revise-space-4: clamp(18px, 1.8vw, 28px);
  --revise-space-5: clamp(26px, 2.8vw, 44px);
  --revise-space-6: clamp(38px, 4vw, 64px);
  --revise-space-7: clamp(56px, 6vw, 96px);
  --revise-space-8: clamp(78px, 9vw, 144px);

  --iam-section-y-sm: clamp(48px, 7vw, 80px);
  --iam-section-y-md: clamp(64px, 9vw, 120px);
  --iam-section-y-lg: clamp(80px, 11vw, 160px);
}


/* src/tokens/radius.css */
:root,
[data-theme="revise"] {
  --revise-radius-sm: 6px;
  --revise-radius-md: 12px;
  --revise-radius-lg: 22px;
  --revise-radius-pill: 999px;
}


/* src/tokens/motion.css */
:root,
[data-theme="revise"] {
  --revise-ease-enter: cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1);
  --revise-ease-travel: cubic-bezier(.65, 0, .35, 1);
  --revise-ease-cinematic: cubic-bezier(.7, 0, .3, 1);
  --revise-ease-standard: cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .2, 1);

  --revise-dur-feedback: 220ms;
  --revise-dur-control: 360ms;
  --revise-dur-panel: 620ms;
  --revise-dur-cinematic: 700ms;
  --revise-dur-scene: 1100ms;
}


/* src/tokens/z-index.css */
:root,
[data-theme="revise"] {
  --revise-layer-content: 1;
  --revise-layer-sticky: 20;
  --revise-layer-scrim: 80;
  --revise-layer-overlay: 100;
  --revise-layer-header: 120;
  --revise-layer-toast: 140;
}


/* src/tokens/shadow.css */
:root,
[data-theme="revise"] {
  --revise-shadow-soft: 0 18px 60px rgba(10, 10, 8, .10);
  --revise-shadow-panel: 0 24px 80px rgba(10, 10, 8, .18);
  --revise-shadow-card: 0 12px 30px rgba(10, 10, 8, .08);
}


/* src/tokens/overlay.css */
:root,
[data-theme="revise"] {
  --revise-overlay-scrim: rgba(8, 8, 7, .42);
  --revise-overlay-blur: 4px;
  --revise-overlay-menu: min(640px, 100vw);
  --revise-overlay-cart: min(520px, 100vw);
  --revise-overlay-discover: min(620px, 92vw);
  --revise-overlay-search: 128px;
  --revise-overlay-gutter: 16px;
}


/* src/tokens/commerce.css */
:root,
[data-theme="revise"] {
  --revise-product-gap: clamp(12px, 1.15vw, 18px);
  --revise-product-media-ratio: 3 / 4;
  --revise-product-card-min: 250px;
  --revise-sale: #8f221b;
  --revise-swatch-size: 18px;
}


/* src/tokens/media.css */
:root,
[data-theme="revise"] {
  --revise-media-radius: 0px;
  --revise-card-radius: 14px;
  --revise-media-dim: .28;
  --revise-media-parallax-scale: 1.12;
}


/* src/theme/base.css */
[data-theme="revise"] {
  color: var(--revise-text-primary);
  background: var(--revise-surface-canvas);
  font-family: var(--revise-font-body);
  font-size: var(--revise-text-md);
  line-height: var(--revise-leading-copy);
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
}

[data-theme="revise"] *,
[data-theme="revise"] *::before,
[data-theme="revise"] *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

[data-theme="revise"] :where(h1, h2, h3, p, figure) {
  margin-block-start: 0;
}

[data-theme="revise"] :where(a, button, input, select, textarea):focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--revise-focus);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

[data-theme="revise"] .iam-action {
  min-height: 44px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 0 var(--revise-space-4);
  border: 1px solid var(--revise-border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--revise-radius-pill);
  text-decoration: none;
  font-size: var(--revise-text-sm);
  font-weight: 650;
  transition:
    transform var(--revise-dur-feedback) var(--revise-ease-enter),
    background var(--revise-dur-feedback) var(--revise-ease-standard),
    color var(--revise-dur-feedback) var(--revise-ease-standard);
}

[data-theme="revise"] .iam-action:active {
  transform: scale(0.985);
}

[data-theme="revise"] .iam-action--primary {
  color: var(--revise-action-primary-text);
  background: var(--revise-action-primary);
  border-color: var(--revise-action-primary);
}

[data-theme="revise"] .iam-action--secondary {
  color: inherit;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--revise-surface-elevated) 84%, transparent);
}


/* src/shell/header.css */
[data-theme="revise"] .revise-announcement {
  min-height: 35px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--revise-surface-inverse);
  color: var(--revise-text-inverse);
  font-size: var(--revise-text-xs);
  letter-spacing: .08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

[data-theme="revise"] .revise-announcement__track {
  width: max-content;
  display: flex;
  gap: 42px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  animation: revise-announcement-scroll 24s linear infinite;
}

[data-theme="revise"] .revise-announcement__track span::after {
  content: "·";
  margin-left: 42px;
  opacity: .5;
}

@keyframes revise-announcement-scroll {
  to { transform: translateX(-50%); }
}

[data-theme="revise"] .revise-header {
  --revise-shell-offset: 89px;
  height: 54px;
  position: fixed;
  left: var(--revise-gutter);
  right: var(--revise-gutter);
  top: 35px;
  z-index: var(--revise-layer-header);
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--revise-space-3);
  padding-inline: 8px;
  color: var(--revise-text-inverse);
  transition:
    top var(--revise-dur-control) var(--revise-ease-enter),
    left var(--revise-dur-control) var(--revise-ease-enter),
    right var(--revise-dur-control) var(--revise-ease-enter),
    background var(--revise-dur-control) var(--revise-ease-standard),
    color var(--revise-dur-control) var(--revise-ease-standard),
    border-radius var(--revise-dur-control) var(--revise-ease-enter),
    box-shadow var(--revise-dur-control) var(--revise-ease-enter);
}

[data-theme="revise"] .revise-header.is-scrolled {
  top: max(8px, env(safe-area-inset-top));
  left: max(var(--revise-gutter), calc((100vw - 1046px) / 2));
  right: max(var(--revise-gutter), calc((100vw - 1046px) / 2));
  color: var(--revise-text-primary);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--revise-surface-elevated) 88%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid var(--revise-border-subtle);
  border-radius: 999px;
  box-shadow: var(--revise-shadow-soft);
  backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
}

[data-theme="revise"] .revise-header__left,
[data-theme="revise"] .revise-header__right {
  min-width: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2px;
}

[data-theme="revise"] .revise-header__right {
  justify-content: flex-end;
}

[data-theme="revise"] .revise-header__brand {
  color: inherit;
  font-family: var(--revise-font-display);
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -.035em;
  text-decoration: none;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

[data-theme="revise"] .revise-header__control,
[data-theme="revise"] .revise-header__link {
  min-width: 44px;
  min-height: 44px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 7px;
  padding-inline: 10px;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: inherit;
  font: 700 var(--revise-text-xs) / 1 var(--revise-font-body);
  letter-spacing: .05em;
  text-decoration: none;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  cursor: pointer;
}

[data-theme="revise"] .revise-burger {
  width: 20px;
  height: 14px;
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
}

[data-theme="revise"] .revise-burger::before,
[data-theme="revise"] .revise-burger::after {
  content: "";
  width: 20px;
  height: 1.5px;
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  background: currentColor;
  transition: transform var(--revise-dur-control) var(--revise-ease-enter);
}

[data-theme="revise"] .revise-burger::before { top: 3px; }
[data-theme="revise"] .revise-burger::after { bottom: 3px; }

html.revise-scroll-locked [data-theme="revise"] [data-overlay-open="menu"] .revise-burger::before {
  transform: translateY(3px) rotate(45deg);
}

html.revise-scroll-locked [data-theme="revise"] [data-overlay-open="menu"] .revise-burger::after {
  transform: translateY(-3.5px) rotate(-45deg);
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  [data-theme="revise"] .revise-header {
    left: 8px;
    right: 8px;
  }

  [data-theme="revise"] .revise-header.is-scrolled {
    left: 8px;
    right: 8px;
  }

  [data-theme="revise"] .revise-header__link {
    display: none;
  }

  [data-theme="revise"] .revise-header__control span:not(.revise-burger) {
    display: none;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  [data-theme="revise"] .revise-announcement__track {
    animation: none;
  }
}


/* src/shell/overlays.css */
[data-theme="revise"] .revise-scrim {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: var(--revise-layer-scrim);
  background: var(--revise-overlay-scrim);
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--revise-overlay-blur));
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition:
    opacity 300ms ease,
    visibility 0s linear 300ms;
}

[data-theme="revise"] .revise-scrim[data-state="open"] {
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
  pointer-events: auto;
  transition:
    opacity 300ms ease,
    visibility 0s;
}

[data-theme="revise"] [data-overlay] {
  position: fixed;
  z-index: var(--revise-layer-overlay);
  visibility: hidden;
  background: var(--revise-surface-elevated);
  color: var(--revise-text-primary);
  box-shadow: var(--revise-shadow-panel);
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  pointer-events: none;
}

[data-theme="revise"] [data-overlay][data-state="open"],
[data-theme="revise"] [data-overlay][data-state="opening"] {
  visibility: visible;
  pointer-events: auto;
}

[data-theme="revise"] [data-overlay-shape="left-sheet"] {
  top: var(--revise-shell-offset, 89px);
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: var(--revise-overlay-menu);
  transform: translate3d(-100%, 0, 0);
  transition:
    transform var(--revise-dur-panel) var(--revise-ease-travel),
    visibility 0s linear var(--revise-dur-panel);
}

[data-theme="revise"] [data-overlay-shape="right-sheet"] {
  inset: 0 0 0 auto;
  width: var(--revise-overlay-cart);
  min-height: 100dvh;
  transform: translate3d(100%, 0, 0);
  transition:
    transform var(--revise-dur-panel) var(--revise-ease-travel),
    visibility 0s linear var(--revise-dur-panel);
}

[data-theme="revise"] [data-overlay-shape="wide-right-sheet"] {
  inset: 0 0 0 auto;
  width: var(--revise-overlay-discover);
  min-height: 100dvh;
  transform: translate3d(100%, 0, 0);
  opacity: 0;
  transition:
    transform var(--revise-dur-panel) var(--revise-ease-travel),
    opacity var(--revise-dur-panel) var(--revise-ease-travel),
    visibility 0s linear var(--revise-dur-panel);
}

[data-theme="revise"] [data-overlay-shape="top-sheet"] {
  top: var(--revise-shell-offset, 89px);
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  min-height: var(--revise-overlay-search);
  transform: translate3d(0, -110%, 0);
  transition:
    transform var(--revise-dur-control) var(--revise-ease-enter),
    visibility 0s linear var(--revise-dur-control);
}

[data-theme="revise"] [data-overlay-shape="anchored-card"] {
  right: max(var(--revise-overlay-gutter), env(safe-area-inset-right));
  bottom: max(var(--revise-overlay-gutter), env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  width: min(394px, calc(100vw - (var(--revise-overlay-gutter) * 2)));
  transform: scale(.82) translate3d(0, 18px, 0);
  transform-origin: 100% 100%;
  opacity: 0;
  transition:
    transform var(--revise-dur-cinematic) var(--revise-ease-cinematic),
    opacity var(--revise-dur-cinematic) var(--revise-ease-cinematic),
    visibility 0s linear var(--revise-dur-cinematic);
}

[data-theme="revise"] [data-overlay][data-state="open"],
[data-theme="revise"] [data-overlay][data-state="opening"] {
  transform: none;
  opacity: 1;
  transition-delay: 0s;
}

[data-theme="revise"] .revise-overlay__inner {
  height: 100%;
  max-height: 100dvh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow: auto;
  padding:
    max(var(--revise-space-4), env(safe-area-inset-top))
    var(--revise-space-5)
    max(var(--revise-space-5), env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
}

[data-theme="revise"] .revise-overlay__header {
  min-height: 54px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--revise-space-3);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--revise-border-subtle);
}

[data-theme="revise"] .revise-overlay__header h2 {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--revise-font-display);
  font-size: var(--revise-display-sm);
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: var(--revise-tracking-display);
}

[data-theme="revise"] .revise-overlay__close {
  margin-left: auto;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: inherit;
  font: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
}

[data-theme="revise"] [data-overlay][data-state="open"] [data-overlay-item] {
  animation: revise-overlay-item-enter 600ms var(--revise-ease-enter) both;
  animation-delay: calc(110ms + (var(--i, 0) * 40ms));
}

@keyframes revise-overlay-item-enter {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translate3d(0, 20px, 0); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
}

html.revise-scroll-locked,
html.revise-scroll-locked body {
  overflow: hidden;
}

[data-theme="revise"] .revise-search-form {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
  gap: var(--revise-space-3);
  padding: var(--revise-space-4) var(--revise-gutter);
}

[data-theme="revise"] .revise-search-form input {
  min-height: 54px;
  border: 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--revise-border-strong);
  background: transparent;
  color: inherit;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: max(16px, var(--revise-text-lg));
}

[data-theme="revise"] .revise-nav-stack__row {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 64px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--revise-space-3);
  border: 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--revise-border-subtle);
  background: transparent;
  color: inherit;
  font: 700 var(--revise-text-lg) / 1 var(--revise-font-body);
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
}

[data-theme="revise"] .revise-nav-stack__row span:last-child {
  margin-left: auto;
}

[data-theme="revise"] .revise-cart-empty {
  min-height: 60vh;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  align-content: center;
  gap: var(--revise-space-4);
  text-align: center;
}

@media (max-width: 767px) {
  [data-theme="revise"] [data-overlay-shape="wide-right-sheet"],
  [data-theme="revise"] [data-overlay-shape="right-sheet"] {
    width: 100%;
  }

  [data-theme="revise"] [data-overlay-shape="anchored-card"] {
    left: var(--revise-overlay-gutter);
    right: var(--revise-overlay-gutter);
    bottom: max(var(--revise-overlay-gutter), env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
    width: auto;
    transform-origin: 50% 100%;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  [data-theme="revise"] .revise-scrim,
  [data-theme="revise"] [data-overlay] {
    transition-duration: 80ms;
  }

  [data-theme="revise"] [data-overlay][data-state="open"] [data-overlay-item] {
    animation: none;
  }
}


/* src/shell/footer.css */
[data-theme="revise"] .revise-footer {
  background: var(--revise-surface-inverse);
  color: var(--revise-text-inverse);
}

[data-theme="revise"] .revise-footer__main {
  min-height: 315px;
  display: grid;
